extras.verified_at_basis: re-checked against the first-party page on 2026-11-19 (a verify run); evidence rows dated by the seed pass, which ended 2026-10-21, keep that date as an upper bound
extras.quota_verbatim: Scale and Scale AI tiers: '$200K - $350k in credits' for startups with verifiable Pre-Seed to Series A funding. Credits apply to 'most Google Cloud platform products ... used in a pay-as-you-go (PayG) or consumption billed format' — which includes Cloud Storage buckets.
extras.limits_verbatim: per-object-cap: GCS single-object max 5 TiB — not binding. request-rate: per-project GCS quotas (raiseable). retention: credits are time-boxed (program is annual, 'Program qualifications change annually'). Excludes educational institutions, government, nonprofits, personal blogs/content, dev shops and consultancies — a startup wrapper is required.
extras.egress_verbatim: GCP egress is metered and comes out of the same credit pool; free egress only to Cloudflare-class partners or via the always-free 200 GB/mo Cloud Storage egress allowance.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Credits are per billing account and explicitly non-transferable ('Credits may only be used by the original applicant and cannot be shared, split, or resold'). The multiplier is *re-application in later years* — Google allows re-applying if credits went unused ('You may still be eligible for credits if you did not use your credits in a previous enrollment'). $200K at coldline-class rates is petabyte-scale for a year; the binding constraint becomes the 12-month expiry, not bytes.
extras.tooling_verbatim: rclone backend 'gcs' (Tier 1), gsutil, GCS XML/JSON API, GCS interop keys give an S3-compatible endpoint.
extras.agent_focus: Programmes that give free storage as a benefit: student / education / nonprofit / startup-benefit bundles. Which ones bundle durable, programmatically-accessible bulk storage, and does it renew?

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
